w: During the evening assembly Swamishri blessed the devotees, "To progress or inspire progress in society, the country or in anyone, then one first requires faith in God. If there is faith then perseverance follows. And that is why one should have faith in dharma, God and the holy scriptures..."

In the evening assembly Swamishri eloquently elaborated on the subject of Faith in God. "God is present in the mandir. If one has faith then only can one come here. If one does not believe that there is God then the question of coming to the mandir does not arise and neither the need for reading the scriptures!
To advance in Satsang, Gunatitanand Swami has said that one requires faith (shraddha), deep spiritual desire (khap) and spiritual association (samagam).

To progress or inspire progress in society, the country or in anyone, one first requires faith (shraddha) in God. If there is faith then perseverance follows. And that is why one should have faith in dharma, God and holy scriptures.

"Secondly one must have khap or else if something disturbing happens then one will give up Satsang. If one is not honored or looked after then one will be critical and bitter towards the organisers. However if one has shraddha and khap then one will always feel that God is true and this mandir is genuine...
"And thirdly one must spiritually associate with a holy sadhu - one who will consolidate dharma, jnan, vairagya and bhakti in one’s life."

Mr. Bill Clinton, the former president of USA, was welcomed by Swamishri during his visit to Akshardham ( see special report ) Swamishri departed from the domestic airport in Amdavad at 5.08 pm and arrived in Mumbai at 7.05 pm. The flight to Dubai took off at 9.05 pm from Mumbai and landed at 9.50 pm Dubai time (11.20 pm, IST). Swamishri was welcomed and honored at the airport with garlands by the local devotees. On reaching Shri P.D.Patel and Shri Rohitbhai Patel's home, Swamishri retired to bed at 11.30 pm (1.00 am, IST).
Around 5.30 p.m. Swamishri departed from Sarangpur and visited Navagam (Lohiyana) and sprinkled flowers from the car and sanctified the land where a hari mandir is under construction.

At 6.35 p.m. Swamishri arrived at Dared village. Dared Bapu Shri Pruthvindrasinh Gohil warmly welcomed Swamishri in the darbar that had been sanctified by Shastriji Maharaj and Yogiji Maharaj. The entire courtyard was filled with devotees and wellwishers from Dared village. After the welcome rituals Swamishri blessed the gathering and performed arti at the BAPS hari mandir in the village. On seeing a vintage car in the mandir ground Swamishri explained that Dared darbar had driven Shastriji Maharaj in the car for pujan and arti of the murtis at the Gadhada mandir. Then Swamishri departed from Dared village.

At 7.30 p.m. Swamishri arrived at Kalatalav after 28 years. In 1975 Swamishri had performed the murti-pratishtha rituals of the hari mandir. Despite the electrical blackout Swamishri performed arti, prostrations and did darshan of Thakorji in the light of an oil lamp. Thereafter Swamishri went to the assembly arranged on a spacious plot of land for the new mandir on the village outskirt.
At 8.45 p.m. Swamishri arrived at Gadhada. After Thakorji's darshan, Swamishri discoursed to the assembly and then had his dinner, retiring for the night at 10.25 p.m.

Mahant Swami Maharaj left the assembly venue by car to return to his residence. Expecting the drive to take some time, the attendants, with Swamishri's permission, began singing the Cheshta (the evening devotional verses describing Bhagwan Swaminarayan's divine actions). But since there was no traffic at all, they reached the residence when the Cheshta was only half done. Swamishri went to his room. An attendant asked: "Swami! Would you like to go to the washroom?"
Walking quickly towards the sofa, Swamishri said: "Later..."
Without saying another word, Swamishri sat on the sofa, closed his eyes and became absorbed in the rest of the Cheshta. Only after the Cheshta was complete did he go to the washroom.
